title: 高松宮記念の後に・悪夢のバッティング

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. I've proven to her that anyone can be a hero if they try hard enough, and that I travel about for the sake of showing that truth to the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We receive some sudden news about Taiki! After the Yasuda Kinen, she apparently plans to fly out to France to be the first to win a European G1!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: She's going after the same race as me—the Prix Jacques Le Marois! I need to run against her in the Yasuda Kinen so I can compare the strength of our possibilities!
